# Vendored ImPlot

Source: https://github.com/epezent/implot (MIT)
Pin: v1.0 @ 524f9fcd48d76c13fdf94c5ffbba8787a1ff7e39

Why vendored: native desktop UI v2 charts (SPEC_UI_V2 §10). Companion to
the Dear ImGui docking pin in ../imgui/. Do not edit these files.

Compiled into `ftd_imgui` (Phase 1a): implot.cpp, implot_items.cpp.
Not compiled: implot_demo.cpp.

Upstream README.md and LICENSE are hashed as-is.
Hashes: MANIFEST.sha256 (enforced by FtdSourceLint.cmake).
